quarterly_data.quarter: AstraZeneca press release: Enhertu plus pertuzumab approved in the EU as first new (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Enhertu regulatory and guideline detail in the EU DESTINY-Breast09 approval release beyond the approval itself: the DESTINY-Breast09 PFS result was HR 0.56 (95% CI 0.44-0.71; p<0.00001) by blinded independent central review, and the Enhertu monotherapy arm remains blinded and continues to the final PFS analysis. Enhertu plus pertuzumab has been included in the ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines as a Category IA 1st-line treatment option for metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer regardless of hormone receptor status. Enhertu followed by THP is approved as neoadjuvant treatment for HER2-positive Stage II or III breast cancer (DESTINY-Breast11) in China, India, Singapore, Brazil and the US (continued approval in China may be contingent on a confirmatory trial). Following the EU approval, a $100 million milestone payment is due from AstraZeneca to Daiichi Sankyo for the 1st-line HER2-positive metastatic indication.
